metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Amistad Reservoir (in southern Texas and northern Mexico) decrease in August 2024 compared to August 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Amistad Reservoir (southern Texas/northern Mexico border, approximately 29.5°N, 101°W) - Time periods: August 2016 vs August 2024 - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-2 for water detection (using NDWI or MNDWI) - I'll use Sentinel-2 for better temporal coverage and flexibility 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds using QA60 band for Sentinel-2 - Use water indices (NDWI or MNDWI) to identify water - Threshold to separate water from non-water 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - C1: If no images found in either period - C2: If all pixels masked out after cloud removal - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A: If water extent decreased (2024 < 2016) - B: If water extent increased or stayed same (2024 >= 2016) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Amistad Reservoir geometry const reservoir = ee.Geometry.Point([-101.05, 29.48]).buffer(15000); // 2. Date ranges const date2016Start = '2016-08-01'; const date2016End = '2016-08-31'; const date2024Start = '2024-08-01'; const date2024End = '2024-08-31'; // 3. Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1024).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(2048).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // 4. Water detection function using MNDWI function addWater(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('water'); const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0); return waterMask; } // 5. Load Sentinel-2 collections let col2016 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(reservoir) .filterDate(date2016Start, date2016End) .map(maskClouds); let col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(reservoir) .filterDate(date2024Start, date2024End) .map(maskClouds); const size2016 = col2016.size().getInfo(); const size2024 = col2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2016 Images: ${size2016}`); console.log(`2024 Images: ${size2024}`); if (size2016 === 0 || size2024 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Create water masks and calculate extent const water2016 = col2016.map(addWater).median(); const water2024 = col2024.map(addWater).median(); // 7. Calculate water area in square meters const stats2016 = water2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: reservoir, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2024 = water2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: reservoir, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2016 = water2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: reservoir, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2024 = water2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: reservoir, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixels2016 = count2016.get('water').getInfo(); const pixels2024 = count2024.get('water').getInfo(); console.log(`2016 Valid pixels: ${pixels2016}`); console.log(`2024 Valid pixels: ${pixels2024}`); if (pixels2016 === 0 || pixels2024 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } const waterArea2016 = stats2016.get('water').getInfo(); const waterArea2024 = stats2024.get('water').getInfo(); console.log(`2016 Water pixels: ${waterArea2016}`); console.log(`2024 Water pixels: ${waterArea2024}`); if (waterArea2016 === null || waterArea2024 === null || waterArea2016 === undefined || waterArea2024 === undefined) { console.log('C3'); return; } const pixelArea = 3000 * 3000; const area2016km2 = (waterArea2016 * pixelArea) / 1e6; const area2024km2 = (waterArea2024 * pixelArea) / 1e6; console.log(`2016 Water area: ${area2016km2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`2024 Water area: ${area2024km2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Change: ${((area2024km2 - area2016km2) / area2016km2 * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); if (waterArea2024 < waterArea2016) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
